home.layout: Sticky dark nav with logo + wide search + cart/profile; horizontal scrollable category strip with 20+ icons; full-width promo carousel; deals-of-the-day row with red countdown timer; 6-column category icon grid; flash sale product grid (5 cols); personalized recommendations grid; app download banner footer-side.

catalog.layout: Breadcrumb bar; two-column layout with 240px left filter sidebar (brand, price slider, rating, delivery, seller checkboxes) and right product grid 4 columns of compact cards showing image, name, bold ruble price, struck old price, green discount %, stars, delivery ETA, orange add-to-cart button.

product.layout: Breadcrumb; three-column top section: left 90px thumbnail rail + main image gallery, center title/rating/seller/specs summary, right sticky purchase box with large price, BNPL installment line, green in-stock, delivery date selector, orange buy button and cart button; below: specs table, reviews with photos, seller's other products carousel, similar items grid.

cart.layout: Two-column: left white card list with thumbnail, name, seller, quantity stepper, price, remove; right sticky 320px summary panel with totals, promo code input, bonus points estimate in pink, delivery options, large orange checkout CTA; below: 'You might also need' cross-sell horizontal scroll.

seller.layout: Seller header banner with name, star rating, review count, registration date and contact button; rating breakdown bars (communication, delivery, accuracy) in a 3-column strip; filter tabs for categories; product grid 4 columns of seller's items with standard compact cards.
